title: Product Layer Module Overview
description: Pure derivations over the product layer without bridge dependencies, testable under plain Node.
body: The product module (PRD §5.7, §5.8, §5.9, §5.12, §12.17, §12.18) provides pure functions and components for the product layer—screens, flows, decisions, and project briefs. Every count is computed from passed-in data at draw time, never cached (PRD §0.4). This module holds no `@openkaava/bridge` calls, so unit tests run under plain Node, the same split the design graph module applies.
